comment: Foundational systems are described as authoritative for legal name, date of birth, sex, and nationality. In practice, authority may be distributed, disputed, incomplete, or vary by attribute and jurisdiction.

anchor.note: p.116-117 l.Lines 118-130 read as the printed page; section 4 agrees

public.text: Foundational systems are described as authoritative for legal name, date of birth, sex, and nationality. In practice, authority may be distributed, disputed, incomplete, or vary by attribute and jurisdiction.
public.suggestedRevision: Define authoritative sources at attribute level rather than assuming one foundational system is authoritative for all demographic attributes. Preserve provenance and conflict-resolution rules.
